snippet.title: LUMENFALL | Official Trailer | Free 2D Action MMORPG for iPhone & Android
snippet.description:
A star fell into the sea of clouds. Where its light touched the sky, islands were born. Now something is devouring the light.

Lumenfall is a free 2D side-scrolling action MMORPG for iPhone, iPad and Android. Walk a path of light, chain combos into screen-shaking ultimates, wield the souls of legends, ride the open sky and take on giant raid bosses with your party.

▶ Play free: https://lumenfall.gg
▶ Discord: https://discord.gg/Vz3y2axCv

Every shot in this trailer is real gameplay, captured in the game.

0:00 The sky
0:24 Five heroes
0:45 The adventure
1:17 Raids
1:45 Play free
